international.headline: United States, Denmark and Greenland agree on a security arrangement
facts: US President Donald Trump announced on 2026-09-18 that the United States, Denmark and Greenland had agreed on a security arrangement to expand and maintain a long-term US military presence in Greenland.
The arrangement includes measures intended to prevent Russia and China from establishing military bases in Greenland and to subject sensitive investments to US security scrutiny.

Denmark and Greenland stated that Greenland’s sovereignty or ownership would not transfer to the United States and that Greenland would remain a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark.
Domestic procedures for the arrangement remained to be completed.
Greenland’s capital is Nuuk; the notes identify Pituffik Space Base as a US military facility there.
international.summary: The announced arrangement concerns a long-term US military presence and security scrutiny of sensitive investment, while Greenland’s status within the Kingdom of Denmark is to remain unchanged.
international.staticLink: Greenland is a self-governing territory within the Kingdom of Denmark, in the Arctic and North Atlantic.
international.prelimsTakeaway: Greenland’s capital is Nuuk; the notes state that sovereignty or ownership will not be transferred to the United States under the arrangement.
international.mainsAngle: Assess the strategic importance of the Arctic and the balance between security cooperation, investment scrutiny and territorial sovereignty.

international.canonicalTopic: Luke Lindberg appointed WFP Executive Director
international.headline: Luke Lindberg appointed Executive Director of the World Food Programme
facts: The United Nations appointed US agriculture official Luke Lindberg as Executive Director of the World Food Programme on 18 September 2026, following approval by the WFP Executive Board.
The appointment was jointly announced by UN Secretary-General António Guterres and FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu.
The notes describe Lindberg as the youngest person to lead the WFP and state that the Executive Director serves a five-year term.
The WFP was established in 1961 and is headquartered in Rome; the notes state that it received the 2020 Nobel Peace Prize.
international.summary: Luke Lindberg was appointed to lead the WFP, which focuses on hunger, emergency food assistance and humanitarian logistics.
international.staticLink: The World Food Programme is part of the United Nations system and is headquartered in Rome, Italy.
international.prelimsTakeaway: The appointment followed approval by the WFP Executive Board; the Executive Director’s term is five years.
international.mainsAngle: Assess the role of multilateral humanitarian agencies in responding to hunger and emergencies.

national.headline: 17th Kathakali Festival held in Chennai
facts: The 17th Kathakali Festival was held at Bharata Kalakshetra Auditorium, Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, from September 18–20, 2026.
Its theme was “Kadha Rasa Sangama – Confluence of Essence of Stories.”
Kalakshetra Foundation, under the Ministry of Culture, organised the three-day festival, featuring Sadanam Academy, Kerala Kalamandalam and Margi Theatre.
The festival opened with “Mandodari,” a Ramayana-based production performed by Sadanam Academy.
Kathakali originated in Kerala and is a classical dance-drama known for elaborate makeup, costumes, facial expressions and hand gestures.
Kalakshetra Foundation was established in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale in Chennai and is an Institution of National Importance under the Ministry of Culture.
national.summary: The Chennai festival presented Kathakali performances from participating institutions and opened with a Ramayana-based production.
national.staticLink: Kathakali is a classical dance-drama tradition originating in Kerala; Kalakshetra Foundation is an Institution of National Importance.
national.prelimsTakeaway: The festival’s theme was “Kadha Rasa Sangama”; Kalakshetra Foundation was established in 1936 by Rukmini Devi Arundale.
national.mainsAngle: Discuss the role of cultural institutions and festivals in sustaining classical performance traditions.

national.headline: Telangana High Court disqualifies Khairatabad MLA Danam Nagender
facts: A Telangana High Court Division Bench comprising Chief Justice Aparesh Kumar Singh and Justice G.M. Mohiuddin set aside the Assembly Speaker’s decision dismissing the disqualification petitions.
The Court held Danam Nagender disqualified from April 23, 2024, under Paragraph 2(1)(a) of the Tenth Schedule and declared the Khairatabad Assembly seat vacant.
Paragraph 2(1)(a) concerns disqualification when a member voluntarily gives up membership of a political party; the Tenth Schedule was inserted by the 52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985.
The judgment was to be communicated to the Assembly Speaker and the Election Commission.
national.summary: The High Court applied the Tenth Schedule’s anti-defection provisions and set aside the Speaker’s earlier decision in the case.
national.staticLink: Tenth Schedule; Articles 190(3)(a) and 191(2); judicial review of Speaker decisions
national.prelimsTakeaway: The Court applied Paragraph 2(1)(a) of the Tenth Schedule and declared the Khairatabad seat vacant.
national.mainsAngle: Examine the operation of the anti-defection framework and judicial review of decisions under the Tenth Schedule.

- **Member:** **Danam Nagender**, **Khairatabad MLA**

> Exam angle: High Court application of Paragraph 2(1)(a), and the Tenth Schedule’s origin in the **52nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1985**.

national.headline: 1965 war veteran and Vir Chakra recipient Alfred Tyrone Cook dies
facts: Flight Lieutenant Alfred Tyrone Cook (Retd.), a Vir Chakra recipient and veteran of the 1965 India–Pakistan War, died on 2026-09-18 aged 87.
During an aerial battle over Kalaikunda Air Force Station, West Bengal, on 1965-09-07, he shot down one Pakistan Air Force Sabre fighter and severely damaged another.
The Vir Chakra was instituted in 1950 and is India’s third-highest wartime gallantry award, after the Param Vir Chakra and Maha Vir Chakra.
national.summary: Alfred Tyrone Cook, a Vir Chakra recipient associated with an aerial engagement in the 1965 war, died aged 87.
national.staticLink: The 1965 India–Pakistan War took place in August–September; the Tashkent Declaration was signed on 1966-01-10.
national.prelimsTakeaway: Vir Chakra is India’s third-highest wartime gallantry award.
national.mainsAngle: The role of air power and individual gallantry in the 1965 India–Pakistan War.
